item.title: JavaScript Monorepo Build Tools in 2026: Nx vs Turborepo vs Rush
item.description: Your CI pipeline just rebuilt every package in the repository — again — even though you changed one file in one library. At 20 packages that is annoying. At 200 packages it burns hours of engineer time and turns every merge into a coin flip on whether the shared cache is warm. Monorepo build tools exist to kill exactly this waste, and in 2026 the JavaScript ecosystem has settled on three serious contenders: Nx (29,318 stars), Turborepo (31,069 stars), and Rush (part of the Microsoft Rush Stack, 6,495 stars). All three are open source, all three are MIT-licensed, and all three were pushed within the last 48 hours — but they approach the problem from surprisingly different angles.
